arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,os,stat,tempfile,subprocess,sys
base=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
file=vault/'growth_model.json'
backup=vault/'.growth_model.backup-before-vpncodeiptv-20261031.json'
sys.path.insert(0,str(base/'scripts'))
from organic_growth import read_model,preview
from telethon_sessions import inspect
assert file.is_file() and not file.is_symlink() and backup.is_file() and not backup.is_symlink()
assert file.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid() and backup.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid()
assert stat.S_IMODE(file.stat().st_mode)==0o600 and stat.S_IMODE(backup.stat().st_mode)==0o600
cfg=inspect(vault)
assert cfg['group'].casefold()=='@iptvpncode' and len(cfg['entries'])==2
original=read_model(vault,cfg['group'])
expected={'schema':1,'target_group':'@iptvpncode','approve_join_requests':True,'owned_channel':'@VPNCODEIPTV','publish_in_owned_channel':True,'publisher_account':1}
restored={'schema':1,'target_group':'@iptvpncode','approve_join_requests':True,'owned_channel':None,'publish_in_owned_channel':False,'publisher_account':1}
assert json.loads(backup.read_text())==restored,'saved_previous_state_mismatch'
if original==expected:
 fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.rea-growth-restore-',dir=str(vault))
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:
   stream.write(backup.read_bytes());stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
  os.chmod(tmp,0o600)
  os.replace(tmp,file)
 finally:
  if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
 print('PUBLICATION_CONFIG_REVERTED',flush=True)
elif original==restored:
 print('PUBLICATION_ALREADY_DISABLED',flush=True)
else:
 raise RuntimeError('UNEXPECTED_CONCURRENT_MODEL_EDIT_NO_OVERWRITE')
assert read_model(vault,cfg['group'])==restored,'revert_readback_failed'
summary=preview(vault,cfg['group'])
assert summary['owned_channel_promotion'] is False and summary['join_request_approval'] is True
print('POST_REVERT_PREVIEW',json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
t=subprocess.run([str(base/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_*.py','-q'],cwd=base,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
print('TEST_RESULT',t.returncode,(t.stdout+t.stderr)[-450:],flush=True)
assert t.returncode==0 and 'Ran 221 tests' in t.stdout+t.stderr and 'OK' in t.stdout+t.stderr
op=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12,check=True)
workers=[w for w in json.loads(op.stdout) if w.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
assert len(workers)==1 and workers[0]['pm2_env']['status']=='online'
print('WORKER_ONLINE',True,'RESTARTS',workers[0]['pm2_env'].get('restart_time'),flush=True)
print('OTHER_PROJECTS_UNCHANGED',True,'POSTING_DISABLED',True,'VOLUNTARY_JOIN_APPROVAL_PRESERVED',True,flush=True)
PY
